Q6097.reason: Modern law treats fee tail language as a fee simple, so the cousin took the whole estate and the grantor had nothing left to convey to the niece.

Q5137.reason: Testifying about what the x-rays showed to prove their content requires the original x-ray films under the best evidence rule.

Q5526.reason: The defendant broke and entered the dwelling with intent to commit a felony (murder) at the moment of entry, satisfying burglary.
